summary: Enhance your skills with our M&E for Community-based Projects Training Course. Learn effective monitoring and evaluation techniques to drive project success.
lede: Monitoring and Evaluation for Community-based Projects gives you practical skills to track progress, assess impact, and understand why an initiative is or is not working. You will learn how to connect data collection with better decision-making in projects involving diverse needs and stakeholders. The course helps you build or strengthen M&E systems and develop adaptable strategies for real-world challenges. You will leave with approaches you can apply immediately to support accountability, effectiveness, and meaningful results.
audienceIntro: This training is crafted for professionals dedicated to measurable success in community-based initiatives:
audience: Data analysts focused on project evaluation
